cases.validation_observation: Provider answer text length was 90 chars while its one citation quote was the 183-char frozen sentence. A provisional claim must equal its cited quote, and answer text must equal joined claims. The route returned only generic invalid_provider_output; the exact validator predicates and raw claim text were not retained. The observed raw 0..200 span width differs from quote length and frozen source offsets, but GroqProvider may repair unique-quote offsets before route validation, so this alone does not establish the failing predicate.
cases.citation_span_repair_behavior: GroqProvider repairs offsets when the quote appears uniquely in selected evidence; raw 0..200 may not be the offsets validated by the app.
